legend: Once upon a time in the Kingdom of Far Far Away lived Sir Lancelot, the chief Royal General. He was very proud of his men and he liked to invite the King to come and watch drill exercises which demonstrated the fighting techniques and tactics of the squad he was in charge of. But time went by and one day Sir Lancelot had a major argument with the Fairy Godmother (there were rumors that the argument occurred after the general spoke badly of the Godmother's flying techniques. That seemed to hurt the Fairy Godmother very deeply).

As the result of the argument, the Godmother put a rather strange curse upon the general. It sounded all complicated and quite harmless: "If the squared distance between some two soldiers equals to 5, then those soldiers will conflict with each other!"

The drill exercises are held on a rectangular n × m field, split into nm square 1 × 1 segments for each soldier. Thus, the square of the distance between the soldiers that stand on squares (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) equals exactly (x1 - x2)2 + (y1 - y2)2. Now not all nm squad soldiers can participate in the drill exercises as it was before the Fairy Godmother's curse. Unless, of course, the general wants the soldiers to fight with each other or even worse... For example, if he puts a soldier in the square (2, 2), then he cannot put soldiers in the squares (1, 4), (3, 4), (4, 1) and (4, 3) — each of them will conflict with the soldier in the square (2, 2).

Your task is to help the general. You are given the size of the drill exercise field. You are asked to calculate the maximum number of soldiers that can be simultaneously positioned on this field, so that no two soldiers fall under the Fairy Godmother's curse.
input: The single line contains space-separated integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 1000) that represent the size of the drill exercise field.
output: Print the desired maximum number of warriors.

legend.ai: 从前，在遥远的遥远王国里，住着皇家总将军兰斯洛特爵士。他为自己的士兵们感到非常自豪，喜欢邀请国王前来观看操练，以展示他所率领小队的战斗技巧和战术。但随着时间流逝，有一天兰斯洛特爵士与仙女教母发生了激烈争吵（有传言说，争吵发生在将军说了仙女教母飞行技巧的坏话之后。这似乎深深地伤害了仙女教母）。
争吵的结果是，仙女教母给将军施加了一个相当奇怪的诅咒。它听起来复杂而且完全无害：“如果某两名士兵之间的距离平方等于 5，那么这两名士兵就会发生冲突！”

操练在一个 n × m 的矩形场地上进行，场地被划分为 nm 个 1 × 1 的方格，每个方格供一名士兵站立。因此，站在方格 (x1, y1) 和 (x2, y2) 中的两名士兵之间的距离平方恰好等于 (x1 - x2)2 + (y1 - y2)2。现在，不能像仙女教母施加诅咒之前那样，让全部 nm 名士兵参加操练。当然，除非将军想让士兵们互相打斗，或者更糟糕……例如，如果他把一名士兵放在方格 (2, 2) 中，那么他就不能把士兵放在方格 (1, 4)、(3, 4)、(4, 1) 和 (4, 3) 中——这些士兵都会与方格 (2, 2) 中的士兵发生冲突。
你的任务是帮助将军。给定操练场地的大小，请计算能够同时站在场地上、且任意两名士兵都不会受到仙女教母诅咒影响的士兵最大数量。

input.ai: 一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n, m ≤ 1000），表示操练场地的大小。
